newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA PROBES HIGH GROUND AHEAD OF RESULT.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA PROBES HIGH GROUND AHEAD OF RESULT.

text.p: Shares in telecommunications group Nokia climbed into new year-high territory on Monday, slightly bettering Friday gains on Wall Street in expectation of a good January-September earnings report, brokers said.
At 1200/1000 GMT Nokia A was up 5.00 markka or 2.23 percent at a new 229.50 markka calendar year-high.
Volume was more than 45 million markka, or 67 percent of total bourse volume on a thinly traded Monday market.
"Expectations are quite high," one broker said referring to Nokia's Q3 interim report due on Thursday, November 14.
The median of analysts' forecasts is for a nine-month profit of 2.2 billion markka, in a range of 2.01-2.43 billion.
